visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a 'Flash Wolves' jersey stands in front of a green, grassy textured wall. He looks directly at the camera and speaks while centered in the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a panoramic wide shot of the Dubai skyline under a bright, clear sky. A massive golden rectangular frame, known as The Dubai Frame, is centered in the urban landscape with high-rise buildings in the background. (3) Return to the indoor green wall setting. The first man continues to speak while a second teammate in the background is focused on his smartphone, partially obscured. (4) A new speaker, a young man wearing glasses and the same team jersey, addresses the camera directly. Behind him, another teammate is seen scrolling on a phone in a casual posture. (5) A taller man in the team jersey takes the lead, gesturing with his index finger to emphasize his points. The lighting is bright and even studio quality. (6) Another man with styled dark hair explains further details, pointing towards the camera. The previous speaker now stands behind him. (7) The final shot shows all six team members standing together in a group formation. A large QR code and promotional graphics are overlaid on the screen.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Multiple young Asian males wearing matching white and black FLASH WOLVES e-sports jerseys with Red Bull logos.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A textured artificial green moss/grass wall indoors, and a wide aerial view of the Dubai city skyline featuring The Dubai Frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice with moderate pitch and clear articulation asks an engaging question. A driving electronic beat with high-energy synths begins as background music. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the transition to a second speaker. The vocal intensity increases as he explains the entry requirements. (3) A new male voice takes over with an animated, positive tone. The BGM remains constant with a strong 4/4 electronic kick pattern. (4) Successive digital UI 'pop' sounds are heard during quick visual cuts to different team members. Each voice is clear and exhibits high vocal arousal. (5) As the list of prizes is announced, additional sparkle and interface sound effects are layered into the mix for emphasis. (6) The final audio phase features a synchronized group shout with high volume and authoritative dominance, followed by a sudden stop of the music and vocals.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Requirement -> Prizes -> Deadline -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Red Bull Tetris tournament in Taiwan and encourage gamers to register for a chance to win a trip to the world finals in Dubai.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the official Flash Wolves e-sports team explicitly promoting the Red Bull Tetris event with brand logos visible and direct calls to action.
